summary: Frontend-only testing for mobile responsiveness + dark/light/auto theme system. Validated theme cycle, localStorage persistence, OS matchMedia auto-resolution, mobile bottom tab bar (buyer + seller), More sheet, sign-out flow, mobile topbar, desktop layout breakpoint, and no horizontal overflow on landing/register. All theme + layout features WORK as specified. One UX overlay issue found: sonner 'Authenticated' toast occupies same top-right region as mobile theme toggle for ~5s after login and intercepts pointer events.

ui_bugs.component: Sonner Toaster (top-right) vs MobileTopbar theme toggle
ui_bugs.issue: Success toast 'Authenticated' (and any top-right toast) sits on top of [data-testid='theme-toggle-btn-mobile'] for ~4-5s post-login because both anchor to top-right of mobile viewport. The toast's <li data-sonner-toast> 'intercepts pointer events' (verified via Playwright elementFromPoint), so a real user tap on the moon icon right after login goes to the toast instead of cycling the theme. Toggle becomes clickable only after the toast auto-dismisses.
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Move Sonner Toaster position to 'top-center' or 'bottom-center' on mobile (or use a media-query-driven position prop on the ThemedToaster), shorten duration, or relocate theme toggle to the left of MobileTopbar on mobile.

issues: Theme toggle overlaps with Sonner top-right toasts on small viewports; consider moving toaster to top-center on mobile to avoid blocking the only interactive element on the right side of the topbar.

theme_system.localStorage_persistence_across_reload: PASS (pref=light retained, html data-theme=light on mount)

not_tested: Admin role tabs (Home/Inbox/Vault/Audit/More) and 10-item More sheet — no admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md
Deal Room Detail (/app/rooms/:id) tabs horizontal scroll on mobile — requires existing room id and navigation depth
iOS safe-area inset padding behavior — not testable in headless Chromium without device emulation
action_items: Reposition Sonner Toaster on mobile (<lg) to top-center or bottom-center, OR shift theme toggle to left side of MobileTopbar. Currently the top-right 'Authenticated' toast blocks the only interactive control on the mobile topbar for ~5s after login.
(Optional) Add admin test account to /app/memory/test_credentials.md so admin nav (5 primary + 10 More) can be regression-tested next iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.jsx ThemeProvider is well-structured: applies data-theme synchronously on mount via useEffect, uses callback form of setState in cycle() to avoid stale closures, correctly cleans up matchMedia listener.
BottomTabBar.jsx — sign-out handler does setOpen(false) then logout() then navigate('/login'). Order is correct, no race. data-testid kebab-casing is consistent with spec.
Layout.jsx uses lg:grid-cols-[260px_1fr] cleanly. main has pb-20 lg:pb-0 to clear bottom tab bar — verified visually no content hidden.
MobileTopbar uses backdrop-blur with color-mix bg — works in both themes; safe-area-inset-top via inline style is correct for iOS.
ThemedToaster (App.js) likely uses a fixed position='top-right'. Recommend conditional position based on window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1023px)') to avoid the topbar overlay collision.

success_rate.frontend: 97% (43/44 functional checks pass; 1 UX overlay issue)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme system, mobile layout, bottom tab bar, and More sheet all verified working at 390x844 and 1920x1080. When testing post-login UI on mobile, wait ~5-6 seconds for the success toast to auto-dismiss before clicking elements at top-right of MobileTopbar (theme toggle), or use page.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-sonner-toast]').forEach(t => t.remove())) to clear toasts. The mobile theme toggle was originally reported as failing in our run until we waited for the toast to dismiss — root cause documented above. Admin role is not exercised due to missing creds.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile theme-toggle-btn-mobile sits at top-right of MobileTopbar (x≈334, y≈8 at 390-wide viewport). Sonner Toaster default position is top-right with y-offset overlapping the topbar. Playwright elementFromPoint(toggle center) returned the <li data-sonner-toast> element instead of the button, confirming click interception. Once the toast auto-dismissed (~4-5s post-login), all subsequent theme cycle / persistence / matchMedia tests passed. Suggested mitigation: set Toaster position='top-center' on viewports <1024px or move ThemeToggle to the left of MobileTopbar.
